claim_text: Architected a governed policy-gated agent execution surface for enterprise AI workflows, combining L0 route-policy dispatch, multi-agent orchestration contracts, and human override escalation paths to keep agentic decisions auditable at scale.
Built CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, pairing partner-led deal support with usage-based subscription forecasting to sustain renewals.
Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows by pairing context engineering with telemetry and rollback controls across production agentic systems.

Standardized the AI systems lifecycle from intake through production monitoring, compressing lab-to-production cycle time from six months to three weeks through managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design.

Engineered high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms, integrating Databricks Lakehouse data pipelines with dense sparse exact retrieval design across cloud environments.
Converted bespoke delivery into commercialized agentic platform capability while scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28 under an operating model for agentic AI.
